description: Historical / baseline behavior prior to Phase C4 Windows matrix execution, supervisor audit, and modal safety enforcement

supervisor_taskkill_race_conditions.scenario: Multiple background supervisors (scripts/cscape_supervisor.py, cscape_watchdog.py, watchdog_cscape_10min.py, src/cscape/lifecycle.py) executing concurrent taskkill /IM Cscape.exe
supervisor_taskkill_race_conditions.baseline_behavior: Blindly terminated running Cscape instances upon minor window state change or timeout, corrupting MFC docking state and killing active GUI
supervisor_taskkill_race_conditions.vulnerability: Destabilized live Cscape process, generated orphaned processes, and prevented reliable visible desktop sessions

naked_launch_com_mta_crash.scenario: Launching Cscape.exe with uiautomation / COM MTA accessibility hooks installed
naked_launch_com_mta_crash.baseline_behavior: Cscape crashed immediately during docking pane initialization with access violation 0xC0000005 in MFC CWnd::GetDC (PUSH [EAX + 20h])
naked_launch_com_mta_crash.vulnerability: Live GUI automation failed closed or repeatedly crashed without pure Win32 message dispatch

baseline_container_mutation_risk.scenario: Automation tests directly modifying and saving artifacts/projects/TankLevelClosedLoop/TankLevelClosedLoop.csp
baseline_container_mutation_risk.baseline_behavior: Saved test modifications directly into the baseline project container
baseline_container_mutation_risk.vulnerability: Corrupted original baseline project hash and risked invalidating Golden Sample verification benchmarks

compilation_modal_auto_yes.scenario: Error Check (32826) triggers Non-Fatal Compilation Errors modal dialog (#32770)
compilation_modal_auto_yes.baseline_behavior: Automated scripts sent BM_CLICK / WM_COMMAND IDYES (6) to force dismissal and claim compilation success
compilation_modal_auto_yes.vulnerability: Masked compilation warnings, syntax issues, and partial builds under false-positive success classifications

visibility_taxonomy_misclassification.scenario: Cscape main window visible on desktop
visibility_taxonomy_misclassification.baseline_behavior: Scripts claimed VERIFIED_LIVE solely based on HWND presence without verifying deep execution readiness or supervisor independence
visibility_taxonomy_misclassification.vulnerability: Conflated mere window visibility with fully verified hardware/live execution

download_command_unverified_gui_lockout.scenario: Live Win32 WM_COMMAND dispatch of ID_PROGRAM_DOWNLOAD (32827) or ID_CONTROLLER_DOWNLOAD (33149)
download_command_unverified_gui_lockout.baseline_behavior: Lacked explicit pre-dispatch security interceptor in GUI automation pipelines
download_command_unverified_gui_lockout.vulnerability: Risked accidental PLC download or unauthorized hardware transmission if connected
